news.title: AI Partner for Vijnabheri, Malappuram District AI Literacy Mission
news.description: upNext joined as AI partner for "Vijnabheri" (Vijnana Bheri) — the AI Literacy Mission and AI Sakshartha Mission by Seethi Sahib Memorial Polytechnic College, Tirur, covering English, Soft Skills, and AI Skills — launched on 21st July 2026.

news.title: FDP Session on AI-Powered Pedagogy at ISS Arts and Science College
news.description: Conducted a Faculty Development Programme session on "AI-Powered Pedagogy: Generative AI for Modern Teaching" at ISS Arts and Science College on 18th July 2026, as part of the EmpowerED 2K26 series, alongside Mohammed Sabeeh P P, Founder & CEO of Xenora Learning.

news.title: Orientation Program on Data Science and Machine Learning at SSM Polytechnic, Tirur
news.description: Conducted an orientation program on Data Science and Machine Learning for final year Diploma in Computer Science Engineering students at Seethi Sahib Memorial Polytechnic College, Tirur, on 19th June 2026.
